about.description:
Dr.Jit is a just-in-time (JIT) compiler for ordinary and differentiable computation. It was
originally created as the numerical foundation of Mitsuba 3, a differentiable Monte Carlo
renderer. However, Dr.Jit is a general-purpose tool that can also help with various other
types of embarrassingly parallel computation.
about.summary: Dr.Jit — A Just-In-Time-Compiler for Differentiable Rendering

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: drjit-cpp
  version: "1.5.0"
  build_number: 1
  llvm_version: "21"
  accelerator_flavor: ${{ "cuda" if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu" }}
  accelerator_build_prefix: ${{ accelerator_flavor ~ (cuda_compiler_version | replace(".", "")) if accelerator_flavor == "cuda" else accelerator_flavor }}

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/mitsuba-renderer/drjit/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 83f29297ecb541bc6725ef2b453eaae98f44f12555e451e7396e925d12105d00
    patches:
      - patches/drjit/0001-Install-drjit-core-headers.patch
      - patches/drjit/0002-Fix-install-destination-paths.patch
      - patches/drjit/0003-Make-directory-before-creating-files.patch
      - patches/drjit/0004-Fix-scatter-for-raw-pointer-target.patch
  - url: https://github.com/mitsuba-renderer/drjit-core/archive/3b96411288b9938889045308654ba37d4ef24b71.zip
    sha256: 66070434bec75c0be64b365acc73dde73fd53819403f7472a652536e3f25c784
    target_directory: ext/drjit-core
    patches:
      - patches/drjit-core/set-coff-object-layer-flags-on-windows.patch
  - url: https://github.com/mitsuba-renderer/nanothread/archive/a2097209e10852962c485ee46d84d28e7a63a1a1.zip
    sha256: 5bd988bc713e516083f6e2e1c8414d5b8087c32ab5aa99a78c662acb327494b1
    target_directory: ext/drjit-core/ext/nanothread
  - url: https://github.com/mitsuba-renderer/cmake-defaults/archive/d65442956cd78772ba26ba25dc552de22566b717.zip
    sha256: 76fc76bc458bf51bd1f7d29f9088b224d93e8fbc8edf4d10767bf962fee48356
    target_directory: ext/drjit-core/ext/nanothread/ext/cmake-defaults
  - url: https://github.com/Tessil/robin-map/archive/f70fd39a960385ef0a963aef00b750e4740228c0.zip
    sha256: eba811574adf28446422a4847053960eb86b06730f4e32db3d6da5d5332f38b9
    target_directory: ext/drjit-core/ext/robin_map
  - url: https://github.com/wjakob/nanobind/archive/86e5626728fc282637a6c338597120913dded1bb.zip
    sha256: 92059b60d06cb7d18245ee58767fb9f899a966eb14bac9bcc5abf6e4674a03a7
    target_directory: ext/nanobind
  - url: https://github.com/Tessil/robin-map/archive/4ec1bf19c6a96125ea22062f38c2cf5b958e448e.zip
    sha256: 78c97483a8993866074f06b25fd288cdb7b8ebd6c61c2f0c43b0e324fd56ce10
    target_directory: ext/nanobind/ext/robin_map

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  skip:
    - cuda_compiler_version != "None" and (ppc64le or aarch64)
    - cuda_compiler_version != "None" and win

outputs:
  - package:
      name: drjit-cpp
    build:
      string: ${{ "cuda" ~ (cuda_compiler_version | replace(".", "")) ~ "_llvm" ~ llvm_version ~ "_" ~ build_number if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else ("cpu_nollvm_" ~ build_number if target_platform == "linux-aarch64" or target_platform == "linux-ppc64le" else "cpu_llvm" ~ llvm_version ~ "_" ~ build_number) }}
      skip:
        - build_mode == "python"
      script:
        file: ${{ "bld_cpp.bat" if win else "build_cpp.sh" }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: ninja
      host:
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
            - cuda-toolkit
        - if: not (ppc64le or aarch64)
          then: llvmdev ${{ llvm_version }}.*
      run:
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: cuda-cudart
        # Dr.Jit's Windows LLVM backend loads LLVM-C.dll at runtime.
        - if: win
          then: libllvm-c${{ llvm_version }}
        - if: not (win or ppc64le or aarch64)
          then: libllvm${{ llvm_version }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("drjit-cpp", upper_bound="x.x") }}
    tests:
      - files:
          recipe:
            - run_test_cpp.bat
            - run_test_cpp.sh
            - tests/
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler("c") }}
            - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
            - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
            - cmake
            - if: unix
              then: ninja
            # Simulate a downstream project that brings its own LLVM dev package.
            - if: linux and x86_64 and cuda_compiler_version == "None"
              then: llvmdev 20.*
        script:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - test -f "${PREFIX}/include/drjit-core/macros.h"
              - test -f "${PREFIX}/include/drjit/fwd.h"
              - test -f "${PREFIX}/share/cmake/drjit/drjitConfig.cmake"
              - bash run_test_cpp.sh
          - if: win
            then:
              - if not exist "%PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\drjit-core\\macros.h" exit 1
              - if not exist "%PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\drjit\\fwd.h" exit 1
              - if not exist "%PREFIX%\\Library\\share\\cmake\\drjit\\drjitConfig.cmake" exit 1
              - call run_test_cpp.bat
      - downstream: momentum

  - package:
      name: drjit
    build:
      string: ${{ accelerator_build_prefix ~ "_py" ~ (python | version_to_buildstring) ~ "h" ~ hash ~ "_" ~ build_number }}
      variant:
        # Prefer the broadly compatible CPU build unless a CUDA flavor is requested.
        down_prioritize_variant: ${{ 1 if accelerator_flavor == "cuda" else 0 }}
      skip:
        - build_mode == "cpp"
        - linux and not x86_64
        - win
        - match(python, "<3.10")
        - match(python, ">=3.13") and cuda_compiler_version == "13.0"
        - match(python, ">=3.14")
      script:
        file: ${{ "bld_py.bat" if win else "build_py.sh" }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - cmake
        - make
        - if: unix
          then: ninja
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - python
      host:
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
            - cuda-toolkit
        - llvmdev ${{ llvm_version }}.*
        - hatch-fancy-pypi-readme
        # Match Dr.Jit 1.5.0's exact PEP 517 build requirement.
        - nanobind ==2.14.0
        - pip
        - python
        - scikit-build-core
        - typing_extensions
      run:
        - ${{ pin_compatible("python") }}
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: cuda-cudart
        - if: osx
          then: libcxx
        - if: linux
          then:
            - libgcc
            - libstdcxx
        - libllvm${{ llvm_version }}
        - python
        - python_abi * *_cp${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}
        - typing_extensions
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - drjit
      - package_contents:
          site_packages:
            - drjit/__init__.pyi
            - drjit/py.typed
            - drjit/llvm/__init__.pyi
            - drjit/auto/__init__.pyi
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pip
            - python
        script:
          - pip check
      - requirements:
          run:
            - python
        script:
          - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
            then: python -c "import drjit as dr, drjit.cuda; assert hasattr(dr.cuda, 'Float')"
          - if: cuda_compiler_version == "None"
            then: python -c "import drjit as dr; assert not hasattr(dr, 'cuda')"
          - python -c "import drjit as dr, drjit.llvm as llvm; x = llvm.Float([1, 2, 3]); y = x + 1; dr.eval(y); assert dr.all(y == [2, 3, 4])"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/mitsuba-renderer/drjit
